title: DecisionCriticVerdict
description: Structured output of a decision-critic review. Lets any host validate the review and lets the orchestrator machine-read the Claims-To-Verify handoff.

verdict.description: Overall judgement. SOUND => one-line why + stop. NEEDS_REVISION for fixable gaps. REJECT only when a load-bearing assumption is both fragile AND irreversible.

text.description: The single best reason this could be wrong.

artifactExcerpt.description: The excerpt from the ARTIFACT the objection rests on.

claimsToVerify.description: Facts the decision rests on that the critic could NOT confirm (it has no tools). The orchestrator MUST verify these before acting on the verdict. A verdict resting on an unverified claim is a hypothesis, not a finding.

whyItMatters.description: What in the decision depends on it.

howToCheck.description: Cheapest way the orchestrator can confirm/refute (e.g. 'grep the source for the symbol', 're-run eval X').

addressed.description: Whether the artifact already addresses this failure mode.

evidence.description: The single piece of evidence that would change the verdict.

option.description: An option from the stated decision space only — never invented.

openQuestions.description: Low-confidence or author-refutable points, demoted out of the findings.
